title.zh: ElevenLabs 给语音 Agent 配上「AI 工程师」：读通话、改配置、自己测试
title.en: ElevenLabs 给语音 Agent 配上「AI 工程师」：读通话、改配置、自己测试

current_state.zh: ElevenLabs added Architect, an AI assistant inside its ElevenAgents enterprise voice-agent platform that diagnoses failures by reading real calls and configurations, edits prompts and workflows, and auto-generates before/after simulation tests with all changes gated behind human review.
current_state.en: ElevenLabs added Architect, an AI assistant inside its ElevenAgents enterprise voice-agent platform that diagnoses failures by reading real calls and configurations, edits prompts and workflows, and auto-generates before/after simulation tests with all changes gated behind human review.
